writer: keycloak-config-cli; serialized with a runtime-owned Lease

managed_fields.realm: Public baseline; master uses separate bootstrap configuration
managed_fields.membership: Explicit private users, groups and optional verified profiles
managed_fields.revocations: Persistent private tombstones override desired state
managed_fields.removal: Explicit retirement and tombstone required; preserve unrelated users and vault credentials
managed_fields.groups: Match full /platform-admin, /developer and /viewer paths; never subgroup basenames

sessions.warning: Logout does not revoke an already issued JWT. Measured managed-client deadlines do not establish deadlines for unmanaged clients.

access.flow: Dedicated confidential OIDC client with PKCE

recovery.policy: Monthly-only coordinated Longhorn/B2; no retained daily local generations
state: CNPG physical database including signing state
Current private membership and revocation registry
recovery.gate: Stop identity writers and server before capture. Keep restored issuer isolated; invalidate sessions and review current credentials, memberships and revocations before reopening.

health.permission: Dedicated realm-health service clients with view-events only
health.audit: Closed five-minute windows; up to 1000 events per category in 100-event pages. Capped windows are incomplete; no identities, IPs, paths or representations
health.completed_jobs: One-hour TTL; retained finished jobs migrate only after later successful health and reconciliation runs

private_source.permissions: ConfigMap only in cloudlab-identity; no prune or empty apply; unavailable source blocks realm import
private_source.file: identity/configmap.yaml; argo-values.yaml is a values input only

security.routing: Use one private HTTPS listener with exact routes and certificate SANs; deny public master, administration, management and client registration paths
security.proxy: Strip forwarded headers; trust only private node Pod ranges and named gateways
security.bootstrap_retirement: Require verified master/platform WebAuthn and independent recovery custody; preserve retired vault items and unrelated users
security.credential_rotation: Preserve unrelated values; verify new credential acceptance and old credential rejection before completion
security.host_clock: Require automatic time synchronization on both hosts before cluster operations
security.token_validation: Enforce expiration, not-before and issued-at; never log claims or tokens
